title: Accessibility
subtitle: Change how Marlowby looks and reads. Your choices are saved in this browser.

profiles.title: Seizure Safety
profiles.description: Stops animation and tones down strong color

profiles.title: Low Vision
profiles.description: Bigger text, underlined links, stronger focus outlines

profiles.title: ADHD Friendly
profiles.description: Stops motion and adds a reading guide

profiles.title: Dyslexia Friendly
profiles.description: Plain font, wider spacing, left-aligned text

readAloud.title: Read aloud
readAloud.hint: Reads the text you've selected, or the whole page.

statement: Marlowby is working toward WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Every page can be used with a keyboard, images have text alternatives, and animations stop if your device is set to reduce motion.
These settings are saved in your browser, so they stay on as you move between pages. Nothing about them is sent to us.
If something on the site is hard to use, tell us through the Help Center and we'll fix it.
